title.zh: 研究称Z.ai的GLM-5.2在发现安全漏洞方面可媲美最新的美国模型
title.en: Researchers say Z.ai's GLM-5.2 matches latest US models at finding security bugs, as critics question the US' lax approach in restricting Chinese open models

summary.zh: 批评者质疑美国在限制中国开源模型方面的宽松态度。

title.zh: 消息称谷歌未能满足Meta对Gemini容量的需求，导致其AI项目受阻
title.en: Sources: Google told Meta around March it couldn't offer all the Gemini capacity Meta wanted to buy, disrupting and delaying some of Meta's internal AI projects

title.zh: 消息称Salesforce员工担忧Anthropic的Claude Tag可能影响Slackbot业务
title.en: Sources: Salesforce staff worry Anthropic's Claude Tag could cannibalize Slackbot and give the AI firm more leverage over the enterprise software industry

summary.zh: 此举可能增强Anthropic在企业软件行业的影响力。

title.zh: GPT-5.6系统卡显示其低于大多数高风险用例，可无延迟发布
title.en: GPT-5.6 system card indicates Sol is well below the level of most worrisome Mythos use cases, suggesting all GPT-5.6 versions could be released without delay

title.zh: 分析显示：AI高暴露职业中22至25岁员工就业率每年下降3.8%
title.en: An analysis of US payroll data across 730+ occupations: employment among workers ages 22 to 25 in highly AI-exposed jobs is now shrinking by 3.8% per year

title.zh: 巴西采用AI驱动的球员选拔应用，通过分析视频片段评估球员
title.en: Brazil, which has struggled to standardize soccer talent scouting, is embracing AI-powered scouting apps that assess players by analyzing video clips and more

title.zh: AI如何影响2026年美国中期选举，公众对数据中心扩张的不满加剧
title.en: How AI is shaping the 2026 US midterms, as public anger grows against data center expansion and the AI industry emerges as one of the biggest financial backers

summary.zh: AI行业成为最大的资金支持者之一。

title.zh: 消息称百度芯片部门昆仑芯计划在香港IPO，目标估值500亿美元
title.en: Sources: Baidu's chip unit Kunlunxin Technology plans a Hong Kong IPO at a $50B target valuation, asking investors to buy chips worth 3-7x their IPO investment

summary.zh: 公司要求投资者购买相当于其IPO投资3-7倍的芯片。

title.zh: LSEG：今年中国大陆科技公司通过上市筹资31亿美元，同比增长5倍
title.en: LSEG: tech companies have raised $3.1B from mainland China stock market listings YTD, up 5x+ from a year earlier, as AI and chip companies drive onshore IPOs

summary.zh: AI和芯片公司推动了境内IPO的增长。

title.zh: 澳大利亚Firmus与Nvidia合作在印尼巴淡岛建设首个数据中心
title.en: Australia-based Firmus partners with Nvidia to build its first data center in Batam, Indonesia; the 360 MW Nvidia DSX AI factory campus is developed with DayOne

summary.zh: 360 MW Nvidia DSX AI工厂园区由DayOne开发。
